heroSubtitle: Neat, precise, high-quality braids in San Antonio, Texas. Over 10 years of experience. My priority is to make you happy.
aboutIntro: Hello, my name is Rose, owner of African Hair Braiding by Alvine, located in San Antonio, Texas.
aboutStory: I specialize in African hair braiding and have been braiding with passion since Africa. I have over 10 years of experience in the hair industry. I previously owned a hair salon which I had to close during Covid-19. Now, I welcome you to my private home salon, a more comfortable and relaxing space to better serve you.
aboutPromise: If you're looking for neat, precise, high-quality braids, I'm the braider for you. My priority is to make you happy.
